original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 26 voltage-probe record has the approved identity, location/status, engineering limits and nominal metadata and remains correct after reboot, while retaining copied chassis fields pending owner disposition.
original_method: Resolve field ownership, then collect complete Type 26 and approved companion structures on the same SUT, normalize encoded voltage/accuracy/resolution/tolerance values and sentinel states against the platform sensor map before and after one approved reboot.
manual_activity: The owner maps source fields, supplies the exact voltage-probe population and encoding/limit expectations, and approves reboot/recovery; automation then performs read-only comparison.
required_inputs: Expected probe count, descriptions, physical locations and status per platform revision
Expected minimum, maximum, nominal, resolution, tolerance, accuracy and OEM-defined values
Raw encoding scale, sentinel, unknown/unpopulated and optional-probe policy
Any retained companion-structure matrices and protected evidence rules
Approved reboot, workload window, boot deadline and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not interpret copied chassis fields as Type 26 or silently discard them
Keep collection read-only; never alter voltage controls, thresholds, firmware or SMBIOS
Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL; no log clearing
Reject unit/scale confusion, invalid min/max/nominal relationships, duplicate locations or unapproved missing probes
Require reboot approval and stop on wrong target, thermal/power anomaly or failed recovery
No automatic retry or inferred probe mapping
agent_execution_scope: Record mixed-structure conflict and verify approved field mapping
Collect full Type 26 and approved companion structures
Normalize encoded fields and validate per-probe identity, range and precision invariants
Compare same-target structures before/after approved reboot
Make no sensor/control mutation, source rewrite, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Map source fields to authoritative structures or approve defect disposition
Approve probe population, encodings, expected values and reboot/recovery
Review missing/duplicate/range/persistence deviations and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: After field mapping, securely archive complete `dmidecode -t 26` and any approved companion structures before/after reboot and parse each probe with raw plus normalized values.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Every listed Type 26 and mixed companion field, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED TYPE 26 PROBE-MATRIX VALIDATION AFTER CONFLICT TRIAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create one normalized record per probe keyed by description/location, retain raw encodings, validate status and engineering relationships, and compare the approved population and metadata across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit encoding and probe-population semantics while rejecting header-only evidence and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Type 26 heading cannot reveal missing/duplicate probes, an invalid status, incorrect unit scaling or inconsistent min/max/nominal/resolution/tolerance/accuracy metadata.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS Type 26 is static metadata and does not prove live rail voltage accuracy. Any live electrical validation is separate coverage and must not be inferred here.

project_override_considerations: Optional probes, OEM values and unknown sentinels must be allowlisted by exact platform/BIOS revision; removing copied companion fields requires an explicit source-governance decision.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and owner field-to-structure disposition
Approved Type 26 probe/encoding matrix and any companion matrices
Complete pre/post raw Type 26 records with normalized per-probe fields
Population, identity, status, range/precision and persistence results
Preserved logs, reboot timeline, no-clear/no-write/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 26 item and command target voltage-probe metadata, but the Procedure additionally requires Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other SMBIOS structures without defining companion ownership.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict recording are complete. Execution waits for field mapping, probe matrix and reboot approval; this does not stop subsequent reviews.

review_improvement: Preserves every source field and adds unit/sentinel, population and engineering-limit invariants needed for meaningful Type 26 metadata validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Voltage-probe fields are encoded metadata with special unknown values; naïvely comparing printed numbers can confuse a sentinel with a real zero or lose scale information. Correctness also depends on relationships such as minimum not exceeding nominal or maximum and on unique location mapping. Complete per-probe raw and normalized evidence is therefore required, while the unrelated chassis fields need an explicit owner disposition.
